title: Petition of the Belmont Municipal Light Department for authorization and approval of depreciation from the statutory rate of three percent to five percent for the year 2004.
filings: DEPRECIATION ORDER- Issued by Commissioners Afonso (Chairman), Connelly, Keating, Manning, Sullivan. DTE 04-28-B

Petition of the Belmont Municipal Light Department for approval of a depreciation rate equal to five percent of the total cost of utility plant in service for the calendar year 2004. By Timothy L. McCarthy, General Manager. DTE 04-28-B
